brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.zh: 「并且」的两半，各自在已知里吗？
hint.en: Are the two halves of the “and” each among the givens?

t.zh: 拼接有两条前提，倒着用它，一个目标变成两个，排成一列。元件总是处理第一个目标；证完一个，下一个顶上来。
t.en: Join has two premises: used backwards, it turns one goal into two, in a row. A part always works on the first goal; when it is proved, the next moves up.
